basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old tech enthusiast based in Harrisburg, PA, trying my hand at building and optimizing PCs in my spare time. By day, I work as an administrative assistant at a local college. Although new to the world of PC building, I'm eager to learn and improve my skills. When I'm not tinkering with hardware, I enjoy playing mobile games like Covet Fashion and exploring personality types. I'm currently single and usually online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in PC building is primarily self-taught through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I started diving into this hobby about six months ago, fascinated by the potential of customizing and optimizing hardware.
